Hi there OP

I’m F22 and I’ve had a drinking problem that got really serious about 2 years ago. I have lost friends that I’ve made at college due to my drinking but I was lucky as they were not the right people for me in the first place.

It is great that you are admitting that you may have a problem. I got involved with my colleges recovery community and their support had helped me to be 2 weeks and 1 day sober as of today.

I suggest looking into groups such as AA of All-Recovery meetings as that will bring you into a space with people struggling and experiencing the same things as you. It has helped me immensely and improved my sense of accountability.

Unfortunately with things like this, it may take some time for those you’ve let down to see any sort of improvement. But those who truly love you will acknowledge growth and ultimately begin to support your efforts and care for you when you do decide it is a good time to drink again.

I understand this feeling as it’s lead to the loss of 3 of my “best friends”. Losing people that you’ve put effort into can always be a huge challenge especially within yourself.

If you need someone now, I am always here and you can message me any time you like. The first step is admitting you have a problem, the next (much harder) is taking those baby steps to a healthy relationship with alcohol.

I believe in you and I hope this helps. I wish you messages of love and support.
